_comment: Beta Slides overlay on the design-system core tokens. The design system ships no accent, link, chart or table tokens on purpose (DESIGN.md section 7: accents are project-specific extensions). This file is the Slides project's extension and is merged into beta/tokens.json by scripts/beta-sync-tokens.mjs on every sync, so a re-sync never loses it. Edit accents HERE, not in beta/tokens.json.

accent6.usage: sixth slot: cream-dark, for tinted plates

folLink.usage: followed or hovered link (folHlink), the sage hover from DESIGN.md section 7

slides._chartPalette: series colours for new charts, as slot names so a moved accent moves its series too; resolved by scripts/build-beta-theme.mjs
